references.text: Here God's promise to Abraham is mentioned, that he would make him a great nation, which forms the basis of Jesus' genealogy.
It tells about the birth of Isaac, Abraham's son, who is a direct ancestor of Jesus.
It covers the story of Isaac's sons, Jacob and Esau, where Jacob becomes the patriarch of the twelve tribes of Israel, including Judah.
It tells about the birth of Judah, one of Jacob's sons, who is a direct ancestor of Jesus.
